note: Generated tables live in mods/COVERAGE.md; scripts/mod_conformance.py checks this file against the host source and the executable evidence.

decisions.decision: Lead model, provider and reasoning route
decisions.observe: `routes.list` returns the routes configured in `host.json` that the mod may see
decisions.alter: no partial edit; a configured route is selected whole
decisions.timing: thread creation, and per request through `model_request` among lead routes on the same provider
decisions.ownership: mod: which configured route; host: the route table, grants, billing and admission
decisions.limits: only configured routes; an unknown or unauthorized name keeps the configured model; arbitrary models, endpoints or credentials are never reachable
decisions.native: native plugins and hooks cannot change model, provider or reasoning effort

decisions.observe: `agents.list`, `agents.result`, `agents.wait` and `task.status` report the caller's agents and the session ledger
decisions.alter: `agents.message` steers a running agent; `agents.cancel` stops it
decisions.timing: any tool, command or lifecycle callback with a live session
decisions.ownership: mod: role, prompt, route, tool ceiling and when to integrate; host: sandbox, worktree, worker limits, accounting and the integrate gate
decisions.limits: worker routes need a current grant; at most 16 records; a writable agent works only in an isolated worktree; integration refuses stale parents, changed candidates and an unmet `integrate` contract gate; optional parent_history requires sessions; failed results retain structured host categories; explicit resume preserves task allowance but never agent handles
decisions.native: native subagents cannot be spawned, limited or integrated by a plugin or hook

decisions.observe: `contract.status` returns the selected document, provenance, receipts and restrictions
decisions.alter: `contract.restrict` only narrows operations; `receipts.submit` adds host-attested receipts; scoped argument predicates can only tighten selected operations; `contract.select` writes the user selection after a native confirmation
decisions.timing: selection at session start; gates at `task.complete` and `workspace.integrate`
decisions.ownership: mod: registers documents and submits receipts; user: selects the document; host: digest pinning, project floor, producer attestation and the gate
decisions.limits: no selection means no gate; an unavailable or changed selection fails closed; a weaker selection needs an exact confirmation; a mod can only ask the user through `contract.select`, whose native confirmation names any lowered assurance
decisions.native: native plugins and hooks have no completion gate

decisions.observe: `routes.list` shows the provider route once ready
decisions.alter: none
decisions.timing: start, resume and turn start
decisions.ownership: mod: registers a granted local provider; host: the grant, loopback address, readiness handshake and accounting
decisions.limits: only a provider granted in `host.json` for that mod; loopback only; unregistered on disable or failure
decisions.native: native plugins can add MCP servers but not model providers

decisions.observe: `task.status` and the `ledger` field of `context` and `terminal` events
decisions.alter: none
decisions.timing: every request
decisions.ownership: host: observes every lead and native sub-agent request; enforces limits on mod agents and on a lead whose model matches a configured lead route with rates
decisions.limits: observation never blocks an unenforced request; enforced requests are admitted, reserved and settled
decisions.native: native hooks cannot see requests or usage

decisions.observe: `model_request`, `response_stream`, `prompt`, `session`, `agent`, `tool_call` and `host_operation` middleware observe in order
decisions.alter: `response_stream` may rewrite unprotected text or stop at an output boundary with an optional retry instruction; `model_request` may pick a configured route; `intercept('model_request')` and `intercept('host_operation')` wrap the route choice and every mod host call as continuations under the caller's grants
decisions.timing: per request and per streamed event
decisions.ownership: mod: the transformation; host: protected fields, boundaries, retry limit and provenance
decisions.limits: protected fields are observe-only; stop only at a completed output item; at most two retries per sampling request; older APIs cannot stop
decisions.native: native hooks cannot see or change the model stream
evidence: node:typed middleware and services register without ambient authority

decisions.decision: Host-routed namespaced and versioned service contracts between mods
decisions.observe: installed contract types and status name provider, consumer, exact version, method, scope and generation
decisions.alter: a consumer supplies only the declared bounded JSON input and receives a schema-kind-checked result
decisions.timing: providers, consumers, versions, collisions and dependency order resolve before activation; calls run through the host during a callback
decisions.ownership: host: provider lookup, capability separation, input/output bounds, generation ownership, call provenance and unload cleanup
decisions.limits: no shared globals, state, secrets, filesystem, network, process authority or inherited grants; optional absence is catchable while required absence, incompatibility, cycles and collisions fail before activation
decisions.native: no equivalent typed inter-plugin service contract in configured Codex hooks
evidence: node:typed middleware and services register without ambient authority

decisions.decision: Mod context block added to each native context assembly
decisions.observe: `on('context')` contributes a bounded fragment
decisions.alter: fragments compose in activation order under one aggregate limit
decisions.timing: every native turn-context assembly, lead thread only
decisions.ownership: host: user/project instructions, native mandatory context, ordering and the aggregate budget
decisions.limits: 1 KiB per fragment, 6 KiB aggregate; mod context is always subordinate developer context and names its mod
decisions.native: `session_start`/`user_prompt_submit` hooks can inject additional context, but there is no exclusive assembler and no declared ordering
decisions.replace_note: the exclusive assembler; observer fragments are dropped with a visible notice

decisions.observe: `intercept('input')` with the thread, text and attachment count
decisions.alter: pass rewritten text to `next`, or return `{deny}`; interceptors compose in continuation order
decisions.timing: before native prompt hooks, skill/mention resolution and history, in TUI and exec
decisions.ownership: host: submission path, attachments, history and the visible notice
decisions.limits: a rewrite or denial is always shown to the user; attachments are retained; a handler returns only what `next` returned or `{deny}`, so it cannot bypass an inner required interceptor
decisions.native: `user_prompt_submit` hooks can block a prompt or add context; competing rewrites are resolved by whichever hook finishes last
evidence: node:lifecycle events and interceptors require their capabilities

decisions.decision: Automatic compaction threshold and local summarization prompt
decisions.observe: the host token limit and context window
decisions.alter: threshold within host bounds
decisions.timing: thread creation and resume
decisions.ownership: host: the compaction engine, the window and remote-compaction behaviour
decisions.limits: 256 tokens to the host ceiling; the prompt applies only to native local compaction, remote compaction keeps native behaviour with a visible diagnostic
decisions.native: `pre_compact`/`post_compact` hooks observe and can add context; they cannot set the threshold or the prompt

decisions.observe: start, resume, idle, stop, tool_result, turn_start, turn_end, compaction_start, compaction_end, agent_end
decisions.alter: not alterable
decisions.timing: at each native lifecycle point, lead thread only
decisions.ownership: host: cancellation, turn cleanup and ordering
decisions.limits: observers cannot run host operations, cannot delay the turn past their budget, and cannot intercept cancellation
decisions.native: hooks cover session_start/end, stop, interrupt and subagent start/stop with comparable observation

decisions.observe: `store.get`, `store.list` and `evidence.read` read the caller's namespace
decisions.alter: `store.put`/`store.delete` with the current revision; `store.reset` with the current generation; `evidence.write` stores content-addressed evidence; `api.state` per mod store, session thread or Git checkout through the manifest `state_scope`
decisions.timing: any callback; `migrate` on a state-version change
decisions.ownership: mod: keys and values; host: namespaces, revisions, provenance, bounds and export
decisions.limits: 256-byte keys, 256 KiB values, 16 MiB and 4,096 keys per scope; stale revisions fail; no cross-mod reads; `api.state` 64 KiB per mod store or 192 KiB per thread or checkout, compare-and-swap writes retried at most twice by replaying recorded host results
decisions.native: native hooks hold no state between invocations

decisions.observe: `sessions.list` and `sessions.read` page visible messages; `sessions.snapshot` freezes complete visible current-thread tool history or selected call/output pairs; `turn_end` carries turn evidence
decisions.alter: none
decisions.timing: any callback; turn evidence at turn end
decisions.ownership: host: repository scope, opt-outs, redaction and bounds
decisions.limits: Snapshots require sessions and store, omit private reasoning and opaque metadata, and refuse missing call/output pairs or oversized history; all evidence remains owner, source and thread bound
decisions.native: native hooks see only the current payload

decisions.decision: Deferred mod tools offered to the model
decisions.observe: the model's arguments
decisions.alter: the tool's own result
decisions.timing: registered at activation; ordinary tools are callable for the whole generation
decisions.ownership: host: the executor, permissions, deadlines, accounting and the tool lifecycle
decisions.limits: 16 tools per mod, namespaced `mod_<id>_<name>`, 8 KiB schema validated by the native tool registry
decisions.native: native plugins add tools only through MCP servers, as a separate process with its own transport

decisions.decision: Task-scoped exposure of optional mod tools
decisions.observe: only the current host checkpoint, thread ID and the mod's own optional tool names
decisions.alter: select a subset of the mod's own task-scoped tools for one sampling step
decisions.timing: after host task state is available and before each step's tool registry is built
decisions.ownership: host: the native tool registry, all other tools, permissions, accounting and callback failure containment
decisions.limits: new API .8 only; a missing, invalid or failed decision exposes no optional tools; an unselected tool is not registered for that step, and a mod cannot name another package's or native tools
decisions.native: Codex has per-step native tool contributors and configured MCP/plugin filtering; no public TypeScript mod choice over its own per-step optional tools existed

decisions.decision: Tool call continuation: transform, retarget, deny, answer or inspect the result
decisions.observe: `intercept('tool')` with the tool, arguments, call, thread, agent, schema and batch position; `next` resolves to the executed result
decisions.alter: pass a changed tool or arguments to `next`, return `{deny}`, transform the result, or answer without running the tool
decisions.timing: before native hooks and permission checks; the result returns after the handler and before upstream truncation
decisions.ownership: host: permissions, the executor and completion evidence
decisions.limits: the effective call re-enters native permissions; a synthetic answer is recorded as `answered_by` and cannot forge completion evidence; a tool runs once per dispatch
decisions.native: `pre_tool_use` blocks or rewrites input; the last-finishing hook silently wins a contested rewrite, no hook can retarget the call or answer it

decisions.observe: the argument text
decisions.alter: display, insert or submit text
decisions.timing: outside native tasks, from the CLI, the `/` popup or a keybinding
decisions.ownership: host: the submission path, queueing and command precedence
decisions.limits: 16 per mod; namespaced `/<id>:<name>` always exists, a bare alias only when unique; submitted text uses the native path with no shell escape; host operations that need a task fail with `host_operation_unavailable`
decisions.native: plugins contribute prompt-style slash commands, not code-backed commands with structured results

decisions.decision: Streamed progress and the transcript activity line
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: up to 32 bounded progress updates per tool call
decisions.timing: during a mod tool call only
decisions.ownership: host: rendering, the live progress panel and the completed activity line
decisions.limits: 1 KiB per update; forwarded once across host-call replay; refused outside a tool callback
decisions.native: hooks can show a status message; there is no streaming progress channel

decisions.observe: Public API 0.2 operation results and owner-scoped events
decisions.alter: Extension-owned selection and interpretation within host grants
decisions.timing: Inside the documented callback or explicitly dispatched plugin command
decisions.ownership: The extension parses its namespace and retrieves content; the host routes the common read tool, binds provider source and provenance, and prevents remote resources from impersonating local files.
decisions.limits: Reserved and colliding schemes fail closed; 16 KiB pages; continuation requires exact revision; handlers can only read workspace files or invoke a granted service.
decisions.native: Pinned Codex does not expose this OMD public extension contract

decisions.observe: the result reports exit status, bounded output, timing, captured stdout digest and the program hash; snapshot commands return candidate-bound host execution evidence
decisions.alter: `sha256` pins the program; `write`, `network` and `unix_sockets` widen only with `fs.write`, `network` and `unix_sockets`; guarded writes recheck bounded command output and named path access under the host operation guard
decisions.timing: any tool, command or lifecycle callback
decisions.ownership: mod: program and arguments; host: resolution, sandbox, environment, limits and cancellation
decisions.limits: 10 s default and 120 s ceiling; 1 MiB per stream normally, or a complete UTF-8 stdout artifact up to 16 MiB with 16 KiB bound pages; artifacts are bound to the same repository, mod source and thread and capped at 64 MiB per binding; 4 concurrent runs; declared environment names only; at most 4 Unix sockets, each named by a declared variable whose host value is a canonical user-owned socket outside the repository; read-only repository without `write`; at most 4 read-only command guards and 128 required write-access paths; selected snapshots are frozen, source changes are refused, and successful execution receipts require zero exit without timeout, signal or truncated output
decisions.native: native hooks run commands outside the session sandbox

decisions.decision: Workspace reads, listings, preconditioned writes and changes
decisions.observe: `workspace.read`, `workspace.list`, `workspace.stat`, `workspace.check_access` and `workspace_change` within the session's effective permission scope; workspace.snapshot captures an owner-bound frozen candidate
decisions.alter: `workspace.transaction`, `workspace.backup`, `workspace.restore` and `workspace.request_rename` with exact preconditions
decisions.timing: tools; lifecycle events; `workspace_pre_rename` during a requested rename
decisions.ownership: mod: paths and contents; host: permissions, preconditions, atomic replacement, backups and change scans
decisions.limits: stale fingerprints fail; `.git` and symlinks are refused; transactions and restores are exclusive per repository within the host; scans are bounded and report `unavailable` instead of partial coverage
decisions.native: native hooks can rewrite a tool's input but not perform checked multi-file writes

decisions.observe: `process.status` reports liveness and idle time
decisions.alter: `process.exchange` sends and receives framed messages
decisions.timing: tools and lifecycle events
decisions.ownership: mod: program and protocol; host: program identity, sandbox, framing, bounds and cleanup
decisions.limits: content-length or NDJSON framing; loopback only with `network`; sessions end with the mod generation, disable or thread stop
decisions.native: native MCP servers are fixed at startup and not owned by a mod

decisions.observe: `sidecars.status` reports liveness
decisions.alter: `sidecars.invoke` sends one bounded request
decisions.timing: tools and lifecycle events
decisions.ownership: mod: when to start and call; host: the grant, program hash, secrets, sandbox and cleanup
decisions.limits: only services granted in `host.json` for that mod; responses are untrusted and bounded; secrets never appear in responses
decisions.native: native plugins can start MCP servers but not supervised, hash-pinned sidecars

decisions.observe: the registry snapshot lists hidden commands and disabled modes
decisions.alter: `api.builtins` hides commands and disables modes
decisions.timing: registered at activation; applied at the next idle boundary; restored on disable, unload or failure
decisions.ownership: mod: which built-ins; host: protected recovery commands and the default mode
decisions.limits: `/omd`, `/quit`, `/exit`, `/approvals`, `/permissions`, `/status`, `/logout` and the default mode cannot be removed; a disabled mode is clamped to default at turn start with a warning
decisions.native: native plugins cannot remove built-in commands or modes

decisions.observe: the `kernel` tool lists configured kernels
decisions.alter: configuration adds kernels; an adapter package wraps a dependent package before activation
decisions.timing: worker start; package activation
decisions.ownership: user: kernel configuration; adapter author: the wrapper; host: driver hashes and capability containment
decisions.limits: a changed driver refuses to start; an adapted package keeps only its own capabilities
decisions.native: native plugins cannot add execution kernels or API adapters

decisions.decision: Terminal base view and composable render-site patches
decisions.observe: the triggering event, checkpoint, real version/installed identity and host presentation phase fresh/started/resumed; current-API observers compose patches after the exclusive base owner
decisions.alter: the owner returns the bounded base view; observers may wrap or replace declared sites and add non-conflicting presentation fields
decisions.timing: repeatable startup presentation before the first editable frame, then every mod event; redrawn inline and fullscreen
decisions.ownership: host: driver, layout, modes, validation, native composer, recovery, input primitives and restoration
decisions.limits: dependency order is deterministic; conflicting or invalid patches fail alone and transactionally; only the current experimental API loads; title suffix and greeting are bounded last-writer scalars; the welcome site uses blank space only and never restores after an accepted start or resume; recovery remains native
decisions.native: native plugins cannot change the terminal at all

decisions.decision: Declarative components at sidebar, header, above-composer, dialog and welcome sites
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: bounded box, text, button, input, select, Markdown, code, pane and dialog trees; wrappers expose exactly one slot
decisions.timing: fullscreen, with inline fallbacks
decisions.ownership: host: focus, scroll, redraw, pointer and keyboard dispatch, resize, accessibility labels, clipboard and the native inspector
decisions.limits: 64 components per site, depth 6, unique bounded IDs and labels; narrow fallbacks apply; controls, raw escapes and arbitrary widgets are rejected
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Palettes, semantic diff/status tones, borders, density, icons and syntax theme
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: bounded named theme slots and presentation variants
decisions.timing: inline and fullscreen
decisions.ownership: host: the terminal colour depth and the configured theme
decisions.limits: 256-colour index or `#rrggbb` mapped to terminal depth; no-color drops custom colors, ASCII uses plain borders, there is no mod animation, and removal restores native presentation
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Generic surface gradients and transformed image/ASCII backdrops
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: `surface_styles` for composer/backdrop/approval framing; backdrop placement, scale, offset, dim, opacity, tint and image overlay paint
decisions.timing: inline or owned viewport render; media cached until resource, transform, environment or geometry changes
decisions.ownership: mod: colors, composition and contrast policy; host: bounded decode/render and native text/semantic preservation
decisions.limits: scale 0.1-4, offsets -4096..4096 cells, dim/opacity 0-1, RGB or indexed colors; no-color drops styling; graphics only detected local Kitty protocol in owned viewport; ASCII/plain-color fallback; decorative backdrops omitted below 60 columns, solid colors retained
decisions.native: hooks cannot style terminal surfaces

decisions.decision: F2-F12, Ctrl/Alt actions and component interaction
decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: insert, submit, run a command, focus a component, activate a control, or request native clipboard copy
decisions.timing: inline and fullscreen while the mod view is active
decisions.ownership: host: native keymap, modal input, focus, pointer dispatch, clipboard authorization and cancellation keys
decisions.limits: Ctrl, Alt and Shift combinations of letters, digits, F2–F12 and named keys; active native bindings and chords win with a visible notice; Escape, Ctrl+C/D/Z/H/I/J/M, Shift+Tab and cancellation remain native
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.observe: not applicable
decisions.alter: a template that retains `{text}` exactly once, compact presentation for successful completed agent tool output, and `inline_sites: 'hidden'` to keep the sidebar, header and named sites out of the inline viewport
decisions.timing: rich streamed and finalized assistant cells and exec cells as they render, including inline scrollback
decisions.ownership: host: the raw transcript, stored messages and durable evidence
decisions.limits: presentation only; active work, failures, user shell commands, prompts, transcript, stored messages and evidence remain native and visible
decisions.native: no equivalent

decisions.decision: Launch identity, styled header lines and width-bounded boxes
decisions.observe: the read-only `identity` on the terminal input: installed Codex version, install profile, effective mode and installed, enabled and active mod counts
decisions.alter: a `line` of styled spans and `box` width bounds
decisions.timing: every terminal redraw on the alternate screen, including Codex's owned fullscreen transcript
decisions.ownership: host: identity values, width fitting and header height; mod: presentation choice
decisions.limits: 12 spans and 256 characters per line; widths 1-500; no mod identity or presentation in upstream-style direct mode
decisions.native: native plugins cannot draw terminal presentation
decisions.replace_note: presentation fields in the terminal view or patch

decisions.decision: Built-in lists, insert, placeholder and glyphs
decisions.observe: none
decisions.alter: components may `{insert}` text; a view may set `placeholder` and width-preserving `theme.glyphs`
decisions.timing: on render
decisions.ownership: mod: rows and spans; host: keyboard handling, the chosen action and width checks
decisions.limits: search input keeps native rendering; width-changing glyphs are ignored; one owner per replacement point
decisions.native: native plugins cannot restyle built-in pickers

decisions.observe: `app_notification` and `app_server_request` for subscribed methods, with coalesced and dropped counts
decisions.alter: `app.request` sends a routed method; only each route's listed fields are accepted, and thread, root and model fields are checked
decisions.timing: user commands and event callbacks; turn-starting methods only from user contexts
decisions.ownership: mod: which routed method; host: the route table, per-method class, contexts, confirmation and thread scope
decisions.limits: only methods in `app.routes`; thread-scoped methods reach the current thread and threads the mod started or forked; local media paths are refused; `mcpServer/tool/call` is confirmed per call; confirmations show the exact parameters and refuse requests over 2,000 bytes; `config/read` redacts MCP server and model provider secret values and URL credentials; config writes reach writable keys and listed sub-keys only (`mcp_servers.<name>.enabled`, plugin enablement and tool lists); `command/exec`, `process/*`, `fs/*`, `thread/shellCommand` and credential flows are excluded; the in-process app-server only (`client_surface_unavailable` otherwise); 256 events / 1 MiB per mod queue
decisions.native: hooks cannot call the app-server or observe its notifications

decisions.observe: `approval` for exec, patch, MCP, network and permission requests; `approval_result` with the deciding source
decisions.alter: deny, or `ask` to force the native prompt; a mod can never approve
decisions.timing: before hooks, automatic review and full-access shortcuts
decisions.ownership: mod: tighten-only policy; host: the decision, the prompt and the record
decisions.limits: a failing middleware falls back to `ask`; the first deny wins
decisions.native: PermissionRequest hooks can approve but run after policy shortcuts and cannot force a prompt

decisions.observe: calls to defined tools reach the `api.dynamicTools` handler as `{name, arguments}`
decisions.alter: `tools.define` adds or replaces a model-visible tool and `tools.undefine` removes it
decisions.timing: at the next model request
decisions.ownership: mod: tool definitions and results; host: schema validation, exposure and admission
decisions.limits: 64 per mod; names distinct from the mod's static tools; native event and tool callbacks only; cleared when the mod reloads
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.observe: `tool_output` with bounded text and byte count after any interceptor result
decisions.alter: observers append up to 4 KiB each (16 KiB total) of feedback
decisions.timing: after the handler returns, before upstream truncation and history recording
decisions.ownership: mod: appended feedback; host: call id, status, the retrievable original and the ledger hashes
decisions.limits: handlers see the first 48 KiB plus a 16 KiB tail; feedback extends any output by at most 16 KiB; image and audio items appear as markers
decisions.native: PostToolUse hooks can add feedback but cannot keep a retrievable original

decisions.observe: `tool_batch` with the parallel-safe calls of one response
decisions.alter: merge several calls into one call of a mod-registered tool
decisions.timing: after the response's calls are known, before dispatch
decisions.ownership: mod: which calls merge; host: admission, approvals, per-call results and attribution
decisions.limits: merged calls run once under a synthetic id; results fan out by call id and missing results become errors; dispatch is unchanged without an owner
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.observe: `tool_specs` with the route and the model-visible tools
decisions.alter: hide or re-describe tools; execution identity is unchanged
decisions.timing: when the tool router is built for a turn
decisions.ownership: mod: descriptions and visibility; host: execution, schemas it accepts and admission
decisions.limits: invalid schemas are ignored; calls still pass through the tool interceptors
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Channels, process events and workspace watches
decisions.observe: `channel`, `process_event`, `timer` and external `workspace_change`
decisions.alter: `events.publish` to a namespaced channel; `workspace.watch` bounded paths; `events.schedule` and `events.cancel` keyed timers for the calling mod
decisions.timing: background delivery at safe points
decisions.ownership: mod: subscriptions and payloads; host: namespaces, queues, watch roots and debounce
decisions.limits: 256 events / 1 MiB per subscriber, drop-oldest with counts; 16 watches and 16 timers per mod (configurable); timers from 1 s to 24 h never start a turn; watches and timers end when the mod unloads or changes; protected and ignored paths excluded
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Credential profiles, secrets and route selection
decisions.observe: `credentials.list` without secret material
decisions.alter: `credentials.request` opens native enroll, refresh or remove flows; `routes.select` picks a configured route for the next request or thread; `sidecars.start` receives the caller's own origin-bound secrets
decisions.timing: user contexts for credential flows; next safe request boundary for routes
decisions.ownership: mod: which profile or route; host: storage, sign-in, injection and expiry
decisions.limits: secrets and tokens never reach the mod runtime or the model; secrets are listed to and removable by their owner only; a missing or expired credential blocks the request
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.observe: `turns.activity` for the current thread: outcomes, tool calls, processes and file changes
decisions.alter: no
decisions.timing: recorded only while an enabled mod's source calls `turns.activity`
decisions.ownership: host: records; mod: reads
decisions.limits: turns before recording started read as unavailable; per-turn lists are bounded and marked truncated
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Layout, notifications, composer and built-in actions
decisions.observe: `component_event` (including ordered, batched key and paste input from focused `keys: true` panes and documents), `view` and `focus`
decisions.alter: `terminal.notify`, `terminal.show_thread`, the read-only `terminal.commands` inventory and `sessions.ports` listeners, confirmed `terminal.import_file` with thread/package lifetime, bounded `terminal.image_sample`, `composer.read`/`write` and `builtins.invoke`
decisions.timing: user commands; composer writes and imports from user contexts
decisions.ownership: mod: content; host: rendering, focus, confirmation and rate limits
decisions.limits: notifications honor terminal settings and a 2 s rate limit; approval key actions and authority commands are refused; imports are 8 MiB maximum; image samples are PNG/JPEG, 4096px per dimension, 120 by 60 RGBA samples; package imports survive config/thread changes but remain repository, owner and exact-source bound
decisions.native: hooks cannot draw, notify, edit the composer or invoke built-ins

decisions.observe: `packages.list` (every store selection with the session's effective, pending and failed state) and `packages.preview`
decisions.alter: `packages.apply` installs, updates, removes, rolls back, enables, disables or re-trusts an edited selection after a native confirmation; `packages.reload` revalidates every selection; `settings.write` saves schema-checked settings for the caller, or with `packages` for another mod, and redraws at once
decisions.timing: user contexts; changes apply at the next boundary
decisions.ownership: mod: request; host: previewed plan, confirmation, trust and lock
decisions.limits: the confirmed plan is applied as previewed; updates resolve dependencies from their index and preview added grants; a changed package, lock or selection refuses; `/omd` stays the native recovery
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.observe: `completion` with the query and upstream candidates
decisions.alter: reorder, filter or add workspace-relative paths; suggest a mod command's arguments from the mod that registered the command, else the owner
decisions.timing: each `@` query result
decisions.ownership: mod: ranking; host: the popup, insertion and stale-result filtering
decisions.limits: 200 items; relative paths only; without an owner upstream ranking is unchanged
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.decision: Opening links, images and native prompts
decisions.observe: no
decisions.alter: `terminal.open` for http(s) URLs or inert files; `terminal.prompt` asks the user to confirm or type text; `image` components
decisions.timing: after a native confirmation for opening
decisions.ownership: mod: request; host: confirmation, file-type allowlist and rendering
decisions.limits: opened files must be documents or images; prompts are answered only by the user; images render as truecolor cells, alt text under `NO_COLOR`
decisions.native: no native equivalent

decisions.observe: `terminal.pty` read returns the screen text
decisions.alter: start (user context, confirmed) a sandboxed shell or named program, then write, read and stop it; panes render in `terminal` components
decisions.timing: while the pane runs
decisions.ownership: mod: session and input; host: sandbox, PTY, rendering and key routing

composition.rule: Activation and dispatch order is deterministic: declared dependencies first, then mod ID ascending. The same order is used for every event, tool listing, command listing and contract listing, and is published in `omd-mod status` as `order`.

`api.on` is middleware: observers compose, may veto (`deny`), contribute additive context, and on the current API contribute bounded terminal patches. `api.replace` is exclusive: one mod per replacement point, claimed at activation. A non-null `routing` or `compaction` decision without replacement fails visibly; older terminal observers also remain observe-only. A context replacer drops observer fragments with a notice naming both sides.

Interceptors compose as one continuation chain per operation: ordinary handlers wrap required ones; each tier follows explicit `before`/`after`, then consumers outside their dependencies, then mod ID and registration order, and a cycle disables its mods. A failure before `next` skips the handler, after `next` keeps the downstream result, a `.catch` handler may answer instead, and a required handler's failure or unavailability fails the operation closed. A reload lets running handlers finish.

Terminal patches apply after the exclusive base in dependency order. Wrappers contain one slot; one patch may replace a site or own completed-tool presentation; duplicate site, key, status-budget or completed-tool claims fail the later mod transactionally without leaking any of its earlier fields.

Contested exclusive claims — a replacement point, a workflow contract ID or a namespaced tool name — are detected before activation and disable every claimant with an error naming all of them. No claimant silently wins, and unrelated mods keep running.

`requires` lists up to four other mod IDs. A dependency that is absent, disabled or itself failed disables the dependent chain before activation; a cycle disables every mod in it. Both are reported per mod and neither stops the host.

Discovery reports project packages shadowing user packages by ID. Trust and activation stay explicit and per path: each selection records its scope, a project-scoped selection takes precedence over a user-scoped one with the same ID, the shadowed selection is recorded and not activated, and the two scopes never share mod state. Two selections of one ID in the same scope both fail closed.

A mod that throws while activating, loses a capability, or is rejected by the store is disabled alone with a source-located error. Every other mod keeps running, its owned agents and services are cleaned up, and a healthy mod keeps its terminal view with the error panel inserted above it. The failure is reported to the user through that panel, `omd-mod status` and the persisted `mod-status.json`; a failure inside a callback is additionally reported to the model for that turn.

Reload happens at a native turn boundary. The initial load isolates per selection; a later reload is transactional — if any enabled selection fails, the previous eligible set stays loaded and the reason is shown once. Stale generations are refused, in-flight work keeps the source it started with, and settings and state survive an edit.

Every callback is cancellable. Cancellation discards the callback's state write, cancels its owned agents and services, records the turn outcome, and leaves the terminal usable; an explicit reload recovers the mod.
Mod tool progress streams into the live panel during the call and leaves one labelled activity line when it completes; replayed host calls never duplicate an update.

Registration, payload, context, progress, host-call and execution budgets are enforced by the host, not by the mod: 16 mods, 16 tools and 16 commands per mod, 1 KiB context fragments under a 6 KiB aggregate, 32 host calls and 32 progress updates per callback, a per-evaluation `hook_budget_ms` with a separate 5 s total for the whole callback including host-call replays, and 64 KiB state.

First-party mods use the published API only. `omd_coordination`, `omd_workspace`, and `omd_recovery` declare ordinary capabilities, carry no private symbol and no per-mod Rust patch, and run under the same package and conformance rules as outside packages.

unsupported: Native workflow-contract enforcement, permissions, spending grants, cancellation, provider credentials, workspace integrity, durable evidence and final acceptance.
Unbounded history rewriting or editing of reasoning and call/output pairs, arbitrary compaction engines, custom prompts for provider-side remote compaction.
Raw terminal escape sequences, arbitrary widgets or DOM/canvas access, overriding approval key bindings, transcript mutation, and clipboard authorization bypass.
Arbitrary provider compatibility, runtime imports other than adapter-declared aliases, and any second scheduler or uncontrolled execution path.
Mod-to-mod calls: `requires` declares presence and order only; mods never call each other or share state.
